title: Alaska News Nightly: Friday, September 11, 2026
text:
Friday on Alaska News Nightly

Firefighters push themselves in memory of first responders who died on 9/11, and Wrangell officials grapple with a wobbling Dungeness crab fishery.

Also, competitive jigsaw puzzlers in Sitka race against the clock — and each other.

Reports tonight from:

Hannah Flor and Ava White in Anchorage,Ashlyn O'Hara in Kenai,Tim Ellis in Delta Junction,Leilani Combs in Wrangell,Alix Soliman in Juneau,Hope McKenney and Lauren Salemo in Sitka,and Colleen Love in Talkeetna.

This episode of Alaska News Nightly is hosted by Wesley Early with audio engineering from Crystal Hyde and production by Patrick Gilchrist.
